<!--
Whole-trial harmonization code for the "Harmonizing all datasets in a trial"
slide. Pulled into the deck with an include shortcode pointing at this file.
-->
```{.r .fragment style="width: 80%; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 1.2em;"}
trialX_configs <- purrr::map(
  list("adverse_events", "demographics", "medications"),
  \x(dataset) read_config_file(get_study_config(dataset, "trialX"))
)

data_models <- purrr::map(
  list("adverse_events", "demographics", "medications"),
  get_data_model
)

trialX_harmonized <- purrr::map2(
  trialX_configs,
  data_models,
  \x(c, m) harmonize_trial_dataset(config = c, model = m)
)
```
